name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan until soft and lightly toasted, then set aside.
Heat the black beans in a small pan and lightly mash them.
Fry the eggs in the olive oil until the whites are fully set.
Layer the beans over each tortilla and top each with a fried egg.
Spoon over the salsa, scatter with cheese, and serve warm.
